dsh-im
https://github.com/xmanrui/dsh-im

Penglai 0.6.0 does not install dsh-im as a runtime and does not copy generated
lib/, bin/, or cordis.patch.yml. Selected channel authentication and transport
ideas may be rewritten into @penglai/im under the MIT license below.
Connection /api management is already implemented as Typert penglaiIm remotes.
